observations.test_mirrors: Every native check of the A/U mirrors passes (test_mirrors_native_fail empty). Bazel reproduces A1 (runfiles values, merge identity, dependency views, FilesToRunProvider reprs, DefaultInfo() fields) and A2 (executable/test builds, ctx.outputs.executable dir, ctx.executable, FullFilesToRunProvider manifest paths, executable merged last in COMPILE order) exactly; rows where Bazel does not reproduce the Rust expectation are listed in test_mirrors_ref_fail.
observations.show_result_order: A2 bin_lazy_unit_test: Bazel lists //pkg:lazy, //pkg:unit_test, //pkg:bin (its own order); since the review round the test compares output names as a set and reads //pkg:bin by label, which both engines satisfy.
observations.review_round: Review fixes recaptured here: Outputs for every rule and Bazel's ctx.outputs/ctx.executable unknown-field texts (vendored unknown_attribute_message hook), 'cannot set .F field of T value', NativeInfo DefaultInfo equality, fresh file-target FilesToRunProvider identity, Bazel's return-value / duplicate-DefaultInfo / orphan-artifact texts, run/run_shell tools, explicit N23f manifest gap; tests/subrules.rs dir(ctx) row asserts only the natively implemented names; A4 compares generated outputs only; A5 mirrors the new bazel_messages_identities_and_action_tools test.
observations.hidden_runfiles: Building an executable builds its default runfiles (genrule data output gen_h1.out) on both sides; a NON-executable target with runfiles also builds them on both sides (gen_h2.out via //e:lib_hidden). Bazel additionally creates <exe>.runfiles/MANIFEST, the runfiles tree and <exe>.repo_mapping; native creates none of them (N23f).
observations.conflicts: Runfiles conflicts never fail or warn on `bazel build` in Bazel 9.3 (B4: symlink vs symlink, file vs symlink, root symlink vs file, root vs root, via a dependency; also with --nobuild_runfile_links, unsupported natively). Bazel MANIFEST (ref_read): later symlink wins (_main/s -> b.txt), an artifact wins over a same-path symlink (_main/c/a.txt -> a.txt), a root symlink wins over the artifact (_main/c/a.txt -> b.txt), later root symlink wins. Native builds the same targets (no manifest); the probe views of the conflicting runfiles are equal (both entries kept in the depset).
observations.executable_cfg_exec: attr.label(executable=True, cfg="exec") builds in Bazel (B5 exec_cfg_tool, output root of the exec configuration recorded); native fails explicitly (configuration transition, N18b).
observations.cfg_host: attr.label(executable=True, cfg="host") is accepted by Bazel 9.3 and natively (B5 cfg_host EXACT).
observations.test_rules: rule(test=True) class names must end in '_test' and non-test classes must not (EXACT_MESSAGE); rule(test=True, executable=True) and rule(test=True, executable=False) are accepted by both; test targets need no '_test' target name (//e:unitname); a test rule returning only DefaultInfo(executable=...) builds on both (no 'Test rules have to define runfiles' error in Bazel 9.3).
observations.args_env: Executable rules accept args=['a','b c'] and a select() of args (EXACT); args needing $(location) or quotes build in Bazel and fail explicitly natively; args on a non-executable rule and args=[1] fail on both (EXACT_MESSAGE). `env`/`env_inherit` are not attributes of Starlark executable or test rules in Bazel 9.3 ('no such attribute 'env' in 'b_test' rule'), natively the same (EXACT_MESSAGE).
observations.testonly: Test targets are testonly: a non-testonly consumer fails on both with "non-test target ... depends on testonly target ... and doesn't have testonly attribute set" (EXACT_MESSAGE); the test-target views use testonly = True.

def _sp(files):
    return [f.short_path for f in files]

def _rf(r):
    return {
        "files": _sp(r.files.to_list()),
        "symlinks": [[s.path, s.target_file.short_path] for s in r.symlinks.to_list()],
        "root_symlinks": [[s.path, s.target_file.short_path] for s in r.root_symlinks.to_list()],
        "empty": r.empty_filenames.to_list(),
    }

def _ftr(f):
    return {
        "repr": repr(f),
        "type": type(f),
        "executable": f.executable.short_path if f.executable else None,
        "manifest": f.runfiles_manifest.short_path if f.runfiles_manifest else None,
        "repo_mapping": f.repo_mapping_manifest.short_path if f.repo_mapping_manifest else None,
    }

def _view(target):
    info = target[DefaultInfo]
    return {
        "files": _sp(info.files.to_list()),
        "default": _rf(info.default_runfiles),
        "data": _rf(info.data_runfiles),
        "files_to_run": _ftr(info.files_to_run),
        "dir": dir(info),
    }

def _lib(ctx):
    out = ctx.actions.declare_file(ctx.label.name + ".txt")
    ctx.actions.write(out, ctx.label.name)
    runfiles = ctx.runfiles(files = [out], collect_data = ctx.attr.collect_data, collect_default = ctx.attr.collect_default)
    if ctx.attr.stateful:
        return [DefaultInfo(files = depset([out]), data_runfiles = runfiles, default_runfiles = ctx.runfiles(files = ctx.files.srcs))]
    return [DefaultInfo(files = depset([out]), runfiles = runfiles)]

    "srcs": attr.label_list(allow_files = True),
    "deps": attr.label_list(),
    "data": attr.label_list(allow_files = True),
    "collect_data": attr.bool(),
    "collect_default": attr.bool(),
    "stateful": attr.bool(),
})

def _probe(ctx):
    a = ctx.file.src
    empty = ctx.runfiles()
    r = ctx.runfiles(
        files = [a],
        transitive_files = depset([a], order = "postorder"),
        symlinks = {"x/./y//z": a, "q/../w": a},
        root_symlinks = {"root/r": a},
    )
    s = ctx.runfiles(symlinks = r.symlinks, root_symlinks = depset(r.root_symlinks.to_list()))
    collected = ctx.runfiles(collect_data = True)
    defaults = ctx.runfiles(collect_default = True)
    print("PROBE " + json.encode({
        "probe": _rf(r),
        "type": type(r),
        "repr": repr(r),
        "symlink_type": type(r.symlinks.to_list()[0]),
        "symlink_repr": repr(r.symlinks.to_list()[0]).startswith('SymlinkEntry(path = "x/y/z", target_file = '),
        "dir": dir(r),
        "merge_identity": [
            empty.merge(r) == r,
            r.merge(empty) == r,
            r.merge_all([empty, empty]) == r,
            empty.merge_all([r]) == r,
            empty.merge_all([empty, r, empty]) == r,
            r.merge(s) == r,
            empty.merge_all([]) == empty,
            ctx.runfiles() == ctx.runfiles(),
            r == r,
        ],
        "merged": _rf(r.merge_all([s, collected])),
        "copied_symlinks": _rf(s),
        "collect_data": _rf(collected),
        "collect_default": _rf(defaults),
        "deps": {str(d.label): _view(d) for d in ctx.attr.deps + ctx.attr.data},
        "alias": [str(ctx.attr.deps[-1].label), _view(ctx.attr.deps[-1])],
        "fresh": [repr(DefaultInfo()), repr(DefaultInfo(runfiles = r).files_to_run), DefaultInfo(runfiles = r).default_runfiles == r, DefaultInfo(data_runfiles = r).default_runfiles == None, DefaultInfo(default_runfiles = r).data_runfiles == None],
    }))
    return []

probe = rule(_probe, attrs = {

    "data": attr.label_list(allow_files = True),
})

def _sp(files):
    return [f.short_path for f in files]

def _rf(r):
    return {
        "files": _sp(r.files.to_list()),
        "symlinks": [[s.path, s.target_file.short_path] for s in r.symlinks.to_list()],
        "root_symlinks": [[s.path, s.target_file.short_path] for s in r.root_symlinks.to_list()],
        "empty": r.empty_filenames.to_list(),
    }

def _p(fn):
    return fn.path if fn else None

def _s(fn):
    return fn.short_path if fn else None

def _exe_file(ctx):
    exe = ctx.actions.declare_file(ctx.label.name + ".sh")
    ctx.actions.write(exe, "#!/bin/sh\necho " + ctx.label.name + "\n", is_executable = True)
    return exe

def _impl(ctx):
    m = ctx.attr.mode
    R = ctx.runfiles
    v = None
    ret = None
    if m == "plain":
        exe = _exe_file(ctx)
        ret = [DefaultInfo(executable = exe)]
    elif m == "toucher":
        exe = ctx.actions.declare_file(ctx.label.name + ".sh")
        ctx.actions.write(exe, "#!/bin/sh\ntouch \"$1\"\n", is_executable = True)
        ret = [DefaultInfo(executable = exe)]
    elif m == "stateful":
        exe = _exe_file(ctx)
        ret = [DefaultInfo(executable = exe, data_runfiles = R(files = [ctx.file.a]), default_runfiles = R(files = [ctx.file.b]))]
    elif m == "stateless":
        exe = _exe_file(ctx)
        ret = [DefaultInfo(executable = exe, runfiles = R(files = [ctx.file.a], collect_data = True))]
    elif m == "files":
        exe = _exe_file(ctx)
        other = ctx.actions.declare_file(ctx.label.name + ".other")
        ctx.actions.write(other, "other")
        ret = [DefaultInfo(executable = exe, files = depset([other]))]
    elif m == "files_empty":
        exe = _exe_file(ctx)
        ret = [DefaultInfo(executable = exe, files = depset())]
    elif m == "lazy":
        ctx.actions.write(ctx.outputs.executable, "#!/bin/sh\n", is_executable = True)
    elif m == "lazy_runfiles":
        ctx.actions.write(ctx.outputs.executable, "#!/bin/sh\n", is_executable = True)
        ret = [DefaultInfo(runfiles = R(files = [ctx.file.a]))]
    elif m == "lazy_same":
        ctx.actions.write(ctx.outputs.executable, "#!/bin/sh\n", is_executable = True)
        ret = [DefaultInfo(executable = ctx.outputs.executable)]
    elif m == "lazy_dir":
        before = [type(ctx.outputs), dir(ctx.outputs)]
        exe = ctx.outputs.executable
        ctx.actions.write(exe, "#!/bin/sh\n", is_executable = True)
        v = before + [dir(ctx.outputs), exe.short_path, exe.basename]
    elif m == "outputs_repr":
        v = [repr(ctx.outputs), str(ctx.outputs)]
        ctx.actions.write(ctx.outputs.executable, "#!/bin/sh\n", is_executable = True)
    elif m == "no_bit":
        exe = ctx.actions.declare_file(ctx.label.name + ".sh")
        ctx.actions.write(exe, "not executable")
        ret = [DefaultInfo(executable = exe)]
    elif m == "no_action":
        exe = ctx.actions.declare_file(ctx.label.name + ".sh")
        ret = [DefaultInfo(executable = exe)]
    elif m == "dep_output":
        ret = [DefaultInfo(executable = ctx.file.src)]
    elif m == "none":
        ret = []
    elif m == "data_only":
        ret = [DefaultInfo(data_runfiles = R(files = [ctx.file.a]))]
    elif m == "default_only":
        ret = [DefaultInfo(default_runfiles = R(files = [ctx.file.a]))]
    elif m == "lib_runfiles":

        ret = [DefaultInfo(files = depset([out]), runfiles = R(collect_data = True))]
    elif m == "outputs_and_exe":

        exe = _exe_file(ctx)
        ret = [DefaultInfo(executable = exe)]
    elif m == "attr_output_and_exe":

        exe = _exe_file(ctx)
        ret = [DefaultInfo(executable = exe)]

    elif m == "conflict_file_vs_sym":

    elif m == "conflict_roots":

    elif m == "conflict_via_dep":

        ret = [DefaultInfo(executable = exe, runfiles = R(collect_data = True))]
    elif m == "conflict_nopolicy_files":
        exe = _exe_file(ctx)
        ret = [DefaultInfo(executable = exe, runfiles = R(files = [ctx.file.a]).merge(R(root_symlinks = {"_main/" + ctx.file.a.short_path: ctx.file.a})))]
    elif m == "manifest_input":
        f = ctx.attr.tool[DefaultInfo].files_to_run
        out = ctx.actions.declare_file(ctx.label.name + ".out")
        ctx.actions.run_shell(inputs = [f.runfiles_manifest], outputs = [out], command = "wc -l < $1 | tr -d ' ' > $2", arguments = [f.runfiles_manifest.path, out.path])
        ret = [DefaultInfo(files = depset([out]))]
    elif m == "repo_mapping_input":
        f = ctx.attr.tool[DefaultInfo].files_to_run
        out = ctx.actions.declare_file(ctx.label.name + ".out")
        ctx.actions.run_shell(inputs = [f.repo_mapping_manifest], outputs = [out], command = "cat $1 > $2", arguments = [f.repo_mapping_manifest.path, out.path])
        ret = [DefaultInfo(files = depset([out]))]
    elif m == "manifest_files":
        ret = [DefaultInfo(files = depset([ctx.attr.tool[DefaultInfo].files_to_run.runfiles_manifest]))]
    elif m == "run_tool":
        out = ctx.actions.declare_file(ctx.label.name + ".out")
        ctx.actions.run(executable = ctx.executable.tool, outputs = [out], arguments = [out.path])
        ret = [DefaultInfo(files = depset([out]))]
    elif m == "run_tool_provider":
        out = ctx.actions.declare_file(ctx.label.name + ".out")
        ctx.actions.run(executable = ctx.attr.tool[DefaultInfo].files_to_run, outputs = [out], arguments = [out.path])
        ret = [DefaultInfo(files = depset([out]))]
    elif m == "run_shell_tools":
        out = ctx.actions.declare_file(ctx.label.name + ".out")
        ctx.actions.run_shell(tools = [ctx.attr.tool[DefaultInfo].files_to_run], outputs = [out], command = "$1 $2", arguments = [ctx.executable.tool.path, out.path])
        ret = [DefaultInfo(files = depset([out]))]
    if v != None:
